rawContent: I was called "sugar tits" and told I wasn't a "serious comedian" today because I was annoyed that people on a thread weren't choosing any women on their top 5 comedians list. I'm tired of being sexually harassed and negged by strange men. So, uh, no #metoo has not gone "too far".

THIS is exactly why I started @hiresurvivors and why I have been advocating to #HireSurvivorsHollywood for years. I have focused on my industry with my initiative but it needs to happen in *every* industry. Start giving us opportunities to work in our chosen fields. #MeToo

The economic impacts of being a survivor are HUGE, so many of us face retaliation, and giving us the opportunities we deserve in our chosen fields is essential. Actions over words. #HireSurvivorsHollywood @hiresurvivors #MeToo

Professional Sports have been a safe haven for domestic and sexual abusers for a long time. Enough is enough. @MLB and @Dodgers you must fire Trevor Bauer. 
#BelieveSurvivors #MeToo

Exactly. So many careers, lives, people's health, relationships, and more have been stolen from them... for no other reason than they had the misfortune of being abused. It's not ok. We must help right the wrong. 
@hiresurvivors #HireSurvivorsHollywood 
#MeToo 
#BelieveSurvivors

Horatio Sanz has been accused of grooming and abusing a child over 20 years ago while (at least some) folks at SNL stood by and let it happen and I hear crickets from the comedy community about it. That's some bullshit. #BelieveSurvivors #MeToo

Russell Simmons is a serial sexual predator and should not be welcome in any circles. Shame on everyone who has welcomed him into their homes, functions, workplaces, fundraisers, and events. #MeToo #BelieveSurvivors @hiresurvivors

Read this thread. Share this thread. The comeback tour of all these abusive men needs to end. It should have never started in the first place. Stop supporting and enabling survivors. @hiresurvivors instead. #HireSurvivorsHollywood #MeToo

An excellent read on the pervasiveness of sexual harassment, what accountability can and should look like, what accountability isn't, how complicity plays into all of this, the fear of retaliation, and so much more. 
#MeToo #BelieveSurvivors #HireSurvivorsHollywood @hiresurvivors

#MeToo has emboldened so many survivors to take action and speak up. Then people and organizations publicly praise them and privately retaliate against them. It's happened to me. It's happened to so many. It's why I started @hiresurvivors. #HireSurvivorsHollywood
